about: Voice files per line id and language, each through a robot-voice preset of tools/voice/robot.py. source: recording (the user's own, placeholder=false), google (Google Chirp 3 HD voice named in 'voice', tools/voice/google_tts.py, placeholder=false) or sapi (Windows SAPI stand-in, placeholder=true). A recording wins over a Google voice, which wins over SAPI (tools/voice/README.md). seconds: length of the Ogg file.
